faqs.a: We use the browser's Intl.Segmenter word segmentation when available. It understands languages that do not use spaces. Older browsers fall back to Unicode letter and number groups.

faqs.q: Are emoji counted as one character?
faqs.a: Yes. We count user-perceived grapheme clusters, so an emoji is one character rather than two UTF-16 code units.
Reading time uses 200 words per minute and rounds up to at least one minute for non-empty text.

faqs.q: Will it change the order of lines?
faqs.a: No. Only empty lines are removed; all other lines keep their original order.

name: Remove Emojis from Text

title: Remove Punctuation — Strip Punctuation Marks Online
description: Remove Unicode punctuation marks from text while keeping letters, numbers, emoji and symbols intact.
intro: Use Unicode punctuation properties rather than a short English-only list, so accented and multilingual text is handled correctly.

faqs.a: Yes. This tool removes punctuation marks only. Use Remove Emojis for pictographic symbols.

name: Word Wrap
title: Word Wrap Online — Wrap Text at Any Width
description: Wrap long lines of text at a chosen column width. Ideal for code comments, descriptions and plain-text emails.
intro: A greedy word-wrap algorithm that keeps words intact and respects existing paragraph breaks.

This is a fairly long

intro: Turn "quotes" and don't into “quotes” and don’t with context-aware opening and closing marks.

faqs.q: Does it handle apostrophes in contractions?
faqs.a: Yes. Straight apostrophes become right single quotation marks, which is correct for contractions.

name: Text Repeater

description: Repeat text instantly with your choice of separator. Useful for test data, patterns and bulk message drafts.

faqs.q: Can I use a custom separator?
faqs.a: Yes. Use \n for a new line and \t for a tab in the separator field.

faqs.a: AP style capitalizes the first and last word and major words. Short articles, prepositions and conjunctions stay lowercase unless first or last.

intro: A complete International Morse converter with clear dot, dash and word separation rules.

They are skipped during encoding rather than replaced with a wrong code.

name: Text to Binary Converter
title: Text to Binary Converter — UTF-8 Text to 8-Bit Binary
description: Convert Unicode text to 8-bit binary using UTF-8 encoding. Accurate for emojis and every language.
intro: Each UTF-8 byte is shown as an 8-bit group separated by spaces.

faqs.q: Why is an emoji more than 8 bits?
faqs.a: Emoji are encoded as several UTF-8 bytes, so they produce multiple 8-bit groups. This is correct.

name: Binary to Text Converter
title: Binary to Text Converter — 8-Bit Binary to UTF-8 Text
description: Decode space-separated 8-bit binary groups back into readable UTF-8 text with clear error messages.
intro: Paste binary groups such as 01000001 01000010 to get AB. Invalid groups are reported, never silently ignored.
instructions: Paste 8-bit binary groups separated by spaces.

faqs.q: What if I paste continuous binary with no spaces?
faqs.a: The tool will report that groups must be 8 bits. Add spaces between each byte.
